newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo rubber prices steady on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombo rubber prices steady on good demand.

text.p: Rubber prices were stable at the Colombo auction despite seasonally high volume coming into the market, brokers said.
"January is usually a good buying month while it is also a good cropping month," an exporter said.

Best Latex one-x, the purest grade, increased to 72.90 rupees per kg from 72.55 on Tuesday when the auction was last held. Crepe number one rose by 50 cents to 72 rupees and RSS 1 shed 30 cents to 64 rupees per kg, brokers said.
There were 212 tonnes of latex, 38 tonnes of sheet rubber and 62 tonnes of scrap on offer at the auction, they added.
"Buyers were actively buying and there was a lot of interest for all grades," said Upali Bandaranayake of brokerage Forbes & Walker.
Buyers were probably buying to build positions, ahead of the forthcoming dry season during which rubber quality and quantity come down, Bandaranayake said.
